sources.title: ruslanmv/Medical-Llama3-8B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository provides a fine-tuned version of the powerful Llama3 8B model, specifically designed to answer medical questions in an informative way. It leverages the rich knowledge contained in the AI Medical Chatbot dataset (ruslanmv/ai-medical-chatbot).

sources.title: Medical-Llama3-8B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Medical-Llama3-8B is a fine-tuned version of Meta's Llama 3 8B model optimized for medical question-answering tasks. Developed by ruslanmv, this model builds on the foundational Llama 3 8B architecture and trains on the AI Medical Chatbot dataset containing comprehensive medical knowledge. The model is designed specifically to generate informative responses to health-related inquiries ...
